title: Electric 80 Concrete Pump Catalogue Row
seoTitle: Electric 80 HBT80 Concrete Pump | Pinjin 60 m³/h
description: Electric 80 is a Xingtai high-capacity electric trailer pump listing 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m / 300 m at 2 cm aggregate, model HBT80-1816-110, 6000 kg. It is not Electric 60 (90 kW, 40 m³/h) and not a truck-mounted boom pump. Match the printed table, then inquire.

answerBlock.what: Electric 80 Concrete Pump is a high-capacity electric trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical (2 cm aggregate), model HBT80-1816-110, hopper 0.7 m³, max aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm, 6000 kg. It is not Electric 60 and not a boom pump or mixing plant.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 60 m³/h, 40 MPa and 900 m / 300 m at ≤ 2 cm aggregate to a high-rise or long-distance pour that can supply the listed 110 kW motor.
factors: Theoretical output 60 m³/h versus Electric 60 at 40 m³/h

110 kW motor and Kawasaki 140 double pump
6000 kg frame versus Electric 60 at 3300 kg

faqs.question: Is Electric 80 the same row as HBT8018?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 80 lists HBT80-1816-110, 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m / 300 m (2 cm aggregate), 6000 kg. HBT8018 lists HBT8018-132S, 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m conveying / 450 m delivery height, 6500 kg. Compare each product page.

faqs.question: Does Electric 80 replace Electric 60?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 3300 kg. Compact frames do not replace the Electric 80 row.
